title: Scientific Defense research-template gallery
communication_job: Demonstrate the editable research slide grammar for evidence-heavy technical decks
visual_direction: Academic navy and white with restrained red conclusions, compact technical structure, and numbered reasoning

content.summary: The Transformer replaces recurrence with attention, enabling parallel sequence modeling while preserving global context.

slides.title: Recurrence creates the bottleneck that attention removes

problems.title: Sequential compute
problems.body: Each state depends on the previous state.

problems.title: Limited parallelism
problems.body: Training cannot process all positions together.

evidence.label: RNN path
evidence.title: O(n) sequential steps
evidence.body: Dependency distance grows with sequence length.

evidence.label: Attention path
evidence.title: O(1) sequential steps
evidence.body: Every position can directly interact with every other position.

content.conclusion: Can sequence relationships be modeled without recurrence?
content.takeaway: Reduce dependency path length to unlock parallel training.

slides.title: Three contributions make the architecture practical

contributions.title: Architecture
contributions.claim: Use attention as the primary sequence operation.
contributions.evidence: Encoder and decoder stacks omit recurrent layers.

contributions.title: Efficiency
contributions.claim: Expose position-level computation to parallel hardware.
contributions.evidence: The sequential operation count no longer grows with n.

contributions.title: Performance
contributions.claim: Retain strong translation quality with lower training cost.
contributions.evidence: Reported BLEU results establish the quality baseline.

content.takeaway: The breakthrough combines representation quality with a shorter computational path.

slides.title: The encoder–decoder stack separates representation from generation

annotations.title: Repeated blocks
annotations.body: Each stack repeats the same layer structure.

annotations.title: Residual + norm
annotations.body: Every sublayer is wrapped with residual flow and normalization.

annotations.title: Masked decoding
annotations.body: Future positions remain unavailable during generation.

annotations.title: Cross-attention
annotations.body: The decoder reads the encoder representation.

content.takeaway: Attention replaces recurrence while the encoder–decoder contract remains intact.

slides.title: Multi-head attention learns several relationship spaces in parallel

mechanisms.label: Scaled dot-product
mechanisms.title: Score and aggregate
mechanisms.body: Similarity weights determine how values are combined.

explanations.text: Each head observes a different representation subspace.

content.takeaway: Attention combines alignment, selection, and aggregation as a parallel operation.

slides.title: The equation exposes every operation in the attention path

equations.label: Scaled dot-product attention
equations.meaning: Normalize query–key similarity, then use the weights to combine values.

equations.label: Multi-head attention
equations.meaning: Run several learned projections in parallel and merge their outputs.

terms.meaning: The information aggregated by attention weights.
A scale factor that controls score magnitude.

content.takeaway: Every output position directly aggregates evidence from the full sequence.

slides.title: Quality improves while training becomes substantially faster

content.takeaway: The architecture improves the quality–cost frontier rather than trading one for the other.
